bio.text: Tim Grayson represents District 9 in the California State Senate; he was previously elected to the California Assembly in November 2016.
He was elected to the Concord City Council in 2010, was reelected in 2014, and served as Concord's mayor in 2014-2015.
He has served as the Concord Police Department's critical response chaplain since 2007, has held a general building contractor license since 1997, and lives in Concord.
